resources.title: chain-reader Starter Template
resources.description: The exact file tree from Lesson 37 (package.json, tsconfig.json, .env.example, .gitignore, and empty src/ stubs for config.ts, chain.ts, and index.ts), pre-wired with the tsconfig settings from Lesson 29 and the dependencies (ethers, zod, dotenv, tsx) the capstone needs — skip the scaffolding and start on the actual logic in Lesson 38.

resources.title: Result<T> + Typed Contract Call Snippet Library
resources.description: The reusable patterns from Lessons 26-30 as copy-paste TypeScript: the Address/Result<T> type aliases, an `as const` ABI example, the generic typed-wrapper-around-readContract pattern, and a zod env-schema template — the same building blocks the capstone's chain.ts and config.ts assemble, ready to drop into a new project without re-deriving them from the lessons each time.
